statusHistory.note: First pin of the São Paulo/Baixada rotation slot under the new post plan; operator-requested by name. ADDRESS CORRECTION IS THE STORY: most listings (Foursquare, Vou de Garfo, Rappi) still carry Rua Minas Gerais 93, Boqueirão — the restaurant MOVED to Av. Epitácio Pessoa 716, Ponta da Praia, per Boqnews dated 27 May 2026, which describes the new two-storey corner house in detail. The article leads with that correction. Dário Costa's record verified against the same piece: born in Santos, THIRD place on MasterChef Profissionais 2016 (an earlier search summary's vaguer 'ex-participante' framing undersold him; the precise fact is third place, not winner), WINNER of Mestre do Sabor 2020. Vou de Garfo is retained as a source for the chef's stated ethos and the wood-oven octopus era but carries the OLD address — flagged here so no future refresh 'corrects' the pin backwards. Hours cross-checked between two aggregators with minor conflicts; article states them with a check-first flag.

Operator dropped a Revista Nove photo (Dário Costa at the restaurant entrance/dining room, from their 7th-anniversary coverage) into content/photo-inbox/ along with its source URL. Replaces the generic Santos-bay fallback that the previous entry's licenseNote had explicitly flagged for replacement. Hosted at Revista Nove's own URL rather than re-hosted locally, matching how every other sourced photo in this repo works. Added the source article to meta.sources as well, per operator instruction.
